sources.name: ONS Beta API
sources.notes: Discovery-first: list → search client-side → dataset → dimensions → options → observations (one wildcard). Rate-limited, no key. Already wired: kernel/evidence/ons.py.

sources.name: Nomis labour-market API
sources.notes: Census, Claimant Count (NM_1_1), APS, workforce jobs. Optional uid lifts limits. Already wired: kernel/evidence/ons.py.

sources.name: Companies House API
sources.notes: All public company data: officers, PSCs, filings. Key needs signup (H-task to obtain, M-task to use after). Streaming API for change feeds.

sources.name: CQC directory API
sources.notes: Providers, locations, ratings, regulated activities. OGL. Verify auth on portal before wiring.

sources.name: FSA Food Hygiene Ratings API v2
sources.notes: No registration, no keys. Geocoded establishments. Version header required.

sources.name: police.uk open data API
sources.notes: Street crime, outcomes, stop-and-search, neighbourhoods. OGL. Location-risk context for retail/hotel/restaurant.

sources.name: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
sources.notes: 24M+ records since 1995, 115-230MB/yr files. OGL (address data via OS/PAF caveat). Builder local comps, hotel site values.

sources.name: ONS MCP servers (community)
sources.notes: brynmrgn/ons-mcp, dwain-barnes/uk-ons-mcp-server, pipeworx gateway. For MCP-native clients; kernel uses raw APIs. See kernel/evidence/MCP_VERDICT.md.

sources.name: EPC Register data
sources.notes: TO-VERIFY: energy certificates by property. Confirm endpoint + auth before wiring. Relevant to builder/hvac retrofit.
